label: Diagram 7
caption: Diagram 7 Pipes penetrating walls
description: The drawing is titled "Diagram 7 Pipes penetrating walls" and comprises two labelled parts. Part (a) is captioned "Short length of pipe bedded in wall, joints formed within 150mm of either wallface. Adjacent rocker pipes of max. length 600mm with flexible joints". It depicts a vertical wall section resting on a base block, penetrated by a single horizontal pipe shown as a series of joined segments. Dimension lines above the wall are marked "150mm max." on the left and right, and further dimension lines along the pipes are marked "600mm max." on each side; star-burst symbols mark the pipe joints. Part (b) is captioned "Arch or lintelled opening to give 50mm space all round the pipe" and shows a wall resting on a base block with a horizontal opening through which a pipe passes, with two small cross-hatched squares at the opening and a dimension of "50" beside a star-burst symbol. To the right, text reads "Mask opening both sides with rigid sheet material to prevent entry of fill or vermin" and "Important Fill void with compressible sealant to prevent entry of gas".
